solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Idiosyncracy'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Idiosyncrasy'.**
 
• The word '**Idiosyncrasy**' is a **noun** which means 'a mode of behavior or way of thought peculiar to an individual'. **(विशिष्टता)**
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• Her habit of using too many commas is just one of her idiosyncrasies.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be** 'Idiosyncracy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Resplendent -** attractive and impressive through being richly colorful or sumptuous **(दीप्तिमान)**
 
• **Dichotomy - **a division or contrast between two things that are or are represented as being opposed or entirely different **(द्वैध)**
 
• **Vernacular -** the language or dialect spoken by the ordinary people in a particular country or region **(स्थानिक भाषा)**
